learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic operation of the main enterprise ERP systems.
Be able to condense information from ERP data and monitor key process indicators (KPIs) using Business Intelligence applications.
Be able to design a balanced scorecard across all management perspectives (learning and growth, internal processes, customers, and financial).

syllabus_topics: From data search to information monitoring
Business Intelligence and Data Visualization Systems: PowerBI
Digital transformation and implementation of information systems in the company
Data and system integration in the company
Governance of artificial intelligence and responsible use of data in the company within the framework of the European Union
Presentation and introduction to the simulator
Business strategy and integration of business functions

assessment_methods.method: Business adventure in the business game (P2) - Company results
Business adventure in the business game (P2) - Final presentation

assessment_rules: For the ordinary assessment, a minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for both the theoretical block and each part of the practical block. If these minimums are met, the theoretical block is weighted 40% (T1) and the practical block is weighted 60% (30% P1 + 30% P2). The final grade is the sum of the theoretical and practical block grades, provided all minimums are reached. Otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. In the extraordinary assessment, a minimum of 4 points out of 10 is required for both the theoretical exam and the practical work. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as (0.4 x Theory) + (0.6 x Practices); otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of this calculation and 4.0.
